provenance.note: Fixed footprint = union(legal, mapped, observed). Observed = JRC occurrence >= 20% components touching the mapped polygon, clipped to a buffer of 0.5 x equivalent radius (60-300 m), computed only at or above 2 ha, dropped and flagged when the union exceeds 3x the mapped area. River sections are kept with status excluded:river-section and the reason. Cascade nodes are referenced by osm_id, not copied. Halo = 1 km buffer of the fixed footprint minus the footprint, computed by consumers.
